author: Solid jj
description:
At the end of Yu-Gi-Oh!: The Dark Side of Dimensions, Seto Kaiba embarks on one final journey to face the Pharah in the egyptian afterlife to play a children's card game. Life or death, nothing shall stop them from kissing and dueling. Except for the fact that they are in ancient Egypt. That does put a hamper in half of that. It's your choice which part I mean.
